reviews.title: Disappointing experience with customer service and refund.
reviews.text: Asked for a refund a month ago and was told it would be up to 12 working days but am still yet to receive it. Reached out to them on chat and was told it was not actioned and still have not received it. Make sure you read the terms and conditions as they do not offer name changes or vouchers so they will take £230 per ticket off of the value of what you paid….. awful customer service - would not use.
reviews.author: Robert D

reviews.title: Do Your Homework
reviews.text: Our family flew from Miami to London on June 14, 2023. When we booked our flight about six months before, we paid for our seats as well. The problem we encountered was Virgin Atlantic was not flying the Airbus to London. They were flying us in a much smaller Boeing aircraft. We had chosen four seats in the middle on the Airbus. Now our family was divided. The aircraft was divided by 2/3/2. Henceforth, we were not able to sit together. The leg room was non existent. This would have been different if we would have flown in the Airbus. It. was awful! I felt I was in a tuna can the entire time. The worst part of all is the airline never notified us of the change in aircraft. Our family was seated elsewhere without reason. The airline explained they do not guarantee the plane that you will be flying. However, when I booked the flight I had to pay for my seats and paid extra to sit together. If the airline cannot promise seats or aircraft, then they should not be allowed to sell them before hand.
reviews.author: Carmen C

reviews.title: Great service. Lots of attention.
reviews.text: Really great flight and service. Lots of attention and means/snacks. Vegan meal on way home tasted awful, but fine aside from that.
reviews.author: Chitch75

reviews.title: Avoid Virgin Atlantic.  Cut-rate airline with dysfunctional systems and offers no customer service
reviews.text: Bottom line: Avoid Virgin Atlantic. They are a cut-rate airline with a dysfunctional website and mobile app. And offer absolutely no customer service. My nightmare with VA started when trying to purchase two tickets on their website. After numerous attempts on their website and also on their mobile app I was still unsuccessful. Each time I got through the entire booking process including payment only to be presented with "Oops! We're sorry ... Unknown error" message (see photo). No information on what to do next. And absolutely no information on website or mobile app on how to get assistance from someone. My wife mentioned that earlier in the day the VA website had a message that maintenance was ongoing and gave a phone number to call for bookings: 888-867-2161. So having nowhere else to turn I called that number. My call was answered by "Charlie" who did not work for VA but said his company handled bookings for VA. OK, so I explained my struggle and he said he could assist in making the booking. Here began an almost two hour ordeal on the phone with "Charlie". While we was polite, it became apparent he had no idea what we was doing. Multiple times we went through the booking process. When he finally completed the booking it was then discovered that passenger information was incorrectly entered. Now came the struggle to fix that. At this point I received email alerts from my credit card provider that two charges were made. One was from VA for the airfare (expected). The other was from "FLIGHT TICKET SITE" for $300. At this point I was still on the phone with "Charlie" and asked about the $300 charge. He proceeds to tell me that the airfare was higher. This sounded like nonsense. Clearly I was being charged an additional booking fee by this third-party outfit. At no time during the phone call was I advised of such a fee or agreed to proceed on the basis of their being a booking fee. As far as I am concerned, Virgin Atlantic owes me a $300 cash refund as they were steering their customers to that phone number. But of course I cannot take up this matter with Virgin Atlantic as they offer absolutely no means to get to customer service. Sadly, I had thought Virgin Atlantic was a better airline. But I see now that they are a cut-rate operation. I strongly advise avoiding them. You'll get no assistance if you run into any problem. There are other, better airline choices out there.
reviews.author: 00000traveler

reviews.title: Abmissmal Customer service
reviews.text: worst customer service, connecting flight cancelled, virgin did not give a monkey, no hotel provision, no help nada. 81yr disabled father meant to fend for himself find a hotel, get to said hotel and wait 3 days for next flight. Delta did absolute best to make this right, but as for Sir Richard Branson, your arline sucks. I called and spent over an hour with your lack of customer support, who when then had ran out of the script customer service moved me to Delta to hold for the next 2 hours before reaching someone. We will be filing for compensation, but reading other reviews looks like that won't be so quick in coming.
reviews.author: nicola d

reviews.title: Great crew, went out of their way to make us feel comfortable
reviews.text: Our holiday to Hawaii was a birthday present for a special birthday. One of the male crew members brought us both a glass of champagne each in champagne flutes. When there was no meal choice left, he offered to bring something from another cabin class. Very friendly and helpful crew which ensured the 11.5 hour flight was enjoyable. I have to say this has not been my experience on other Virgin flights or airlines where mostly the cabin crew give the impression that passengers are just a nuisance and hide away, never to be seen. If you do approach them (on other flights) they make you feel that you are disturbing them as they are always eating or drinking. Thanks for contributing to giving my holiday a great start.
reviews.author: MMG

reviews.title: All good, (nearly), as usual
reviews.text: We flew from Heathrow to Vegas on Mat 28th, returning on June 4th. As usual with Virgin, the booking, check-in, boarding, & flight all went smoothly & on time. As always, the virgin staff were all great. Once boarded I found that my seat would not stay in the upright position and fell to the reclined position, a member of the virgin staff got someone to tinker with it and got it to stay upright. On our return flight a week later, same plane, same seat was still faulty and needed a little more tinkering to sort it. Seems that a week would be long enough to sort it. The flight was fine, the food was awful, as always, but just what is expected in cattle class! During the 5 months or so that the holiday was booked, I tried many times to book extra leg-room seats. These always showed as "un-occupied but may be occupied by the time of our flight". I could understand if these seats were held back for passengers with special needs, but these seats were occupied by ordinary people on our flights. Why was I unable to book these seats in advance? I can`t face another 10 hour flight in cattle class!! All in all, Virgin are still a great company apart from the small annoyances.
reviews.author: Daniel Matless

reviews.title: Inconsistent Customers Service demonstrate tokenism & lip service in complaints procedure - rude staff.
reviews.text: Having previously had good experiences travelling with Virgin to California (LAX & SFO) decided to take kids with me on this before I stayed on to work. As knew daughter would be hyper anxious and had booked flights in advance also booked and paid Holiday Extras access to Club lounge for family so daughter could calm down with mum and sister before they flew back and left me. Check in went ok and no indications of any problems. Get to the lounge and denied entry despite booking and paperwork evident by rude desk staff who said it was not policy but would not put in writing. Had to escalate to site manager who explain that management had changed in March so would not honour previous practice. Did agree to send letter so we could claim refund. Daughters found quite space in airport to sit and calm down distressed. Complained through Virgin channels who basically said not their fault as policy not to sell access and we need to claim through ticketing agent. Did not pick up on change of policy or rude staff , responded back that was not looking for refund rather pressing point that if policies change they should ensure all customers are advised and these risks are picked up on transfer also point of staff rudeness. Response back from Virgin complaints not their issue as current policy applies. Did not pick up on policy change which their US staff confirmed had happened. Not a proper complaints procedure or root cause analysis for learning, not caring at all for vulnerable passengers. Lip service and glossy adds do not match true behaviours or values. disappointing tokenistic complaint procedure and customer service. Next flights we have choice on revert back to star alliance or sky team partners.
reviews.author: Joseph M

reviews.title: Terrible customer service in cancelling flight
reviews.text: I have been trying to process a refund since 5th May (now 22nd June) and have yet to receive my refund after having called 4 times now. I haven't received one email response throughout this - even though this was the prescribed mode of communication to apply for and confirm refund - resulting in having to call Virgin each time. Even till now, I have been informed that it has been scheduled for payment but have been unfortunately inconvenienced by Virgin taking inconsiderately long to process a refund.
reviews.author: David O

reviews.title: Paid for premium, did not get our seats
reviews.text: We purchased Premium seats. After checkout there were no premium seats. So they sold us something they did NOT have. This is illegal. We were forced to purchase the same seats again. We had already bought Premoum seats. We were forced to purchase them again people!!!! Classic bait and switch, which is illegal. I wish I could do more than this...
reviews.author: Dan C

reviews.title: Great Airline
reviews.text: First time flying with Virgin. Great aircraft with fantastic entertainment systems. Seats in economy have plenty of space and recline a decent amount. In-Flight service was good.
reviews.author: Chris M

reviews.title: Standards have plummeted.
reviews.text: Flew from Manchester to New York in May with Virgin Atlantic. Ì have flown with them previously and it's fair to say their standards really have plummeted. Aircraft dated and tired, and the staff unfriendly and untidy. One of the worst flights I've ever been on and extremely uncomfortable. The plane seemed to have very little space (even before the couple in front reclined their seats) you get more room on a Jet2 flight to spain! The food on the flight back was abysmal - a night through to morning flight so it included an evening meal (we were told it was chicken pie although it looked, and tasted, like grey cardboard) and breakfast consisting of a blueberry muffin, blueberry Greek yoghurt and a blueberry granola bar; presumably Branson has shares in a blueberry farm. Basically if you don't like blueberries (which we don't) book yourself in for a full English once landed. Only booked to fly with Virgin over another airline due to the exceptional service provided in the past, but after this recent experience I'd never fly with them (or recommend them to others) ever again.
reviews.author: Orv

reviews.title: Awesome food, very comfortable, amazing staff and super nice bathrooms. the staff where so friendly amazing flight!
reviews.text: This was one of my favorite flights ever. super friendly staff, food was awesome, and bathrooms where super clean super big and super fancy this was so awesome!
reviews.author: Michael L

reviews.title: Still a good product but area’s to work on.
reviews.text: I’m a tall traveller, 6ft5 so once I’ve bought a ticket, seat allocation becomes the next important task (cost). For each flight, to ensure comfort I shell out £75. It’s expensive and feels like a height tax but to avoid cramped conditions it’s a necessary cost. What annoys me though is within minutes of take off (and despite an announcement to tell passengers to not move to exit rows) they are invariably occupied by passengers. Feels like I’m subsidising the row! really do hope Virgin can find a fix for this, maybe give extra points to people who purchase exit rows? The food was t the best- being a big unit, the small potions leave you hungry so would advise taking a sandwich or something else to eat. Staff great as always- just wish they could lay attention to the exit rows and respect those of us who’ve actually paid.
reviews.author: Lumpy73

reviews.title: More like virgin pathetic
reviews.text: Our BA flight was cancelled and we were offered the chance to fly virgin Atlantic upper class. We have flown BA business class many time and although they didn’t cover themselves with glory on this holiday they have generally been excellent, So we arrived at Miami airport three and a half hours before take off to find nobody on hand at the virgin checkin desks or anywhere else for that matter waited for about 30 mins before 4 - 5 virgin staff suddenly appeared from a door and put a sign up saying check in would start in 20 mins time then back through the door the same way they appeared. As the notice said they came again 20 mins later and proceeded to open economy class and started checking in economy passengers first still nobody at upper or premium economy then out came 2 more “staff” where a miserable looking lady chewing gum came over to start checking in upper class. we waited our turn and I asked the lady if chewing gum was part of virgins welcoming policy to which she stopped chewing and made no comment but looked more frosty than before when i asked her why economy check in was opened before upper class she replied because more people fly economy……great answer so bare that in mind when you part with your money for upper class. After the check in experience we headed for the business lounge which was clean and nice enough so that was ok, then flight time arrived once on the aircraft the cabin was clean but the staff where generally absence and not very attentive the seats were awful very cramped due to having far too many tops to put things on and when you lowered to a flat bed i had to lye on my side as the width was so narrow i couldn't fit to watch the tv. i'm glad i had the chance to try this virgin upper class product at British airways expense i certainly wouldn't recommend it and i think the new BA business class model is far superior and better VFM.
reviews.author: niggle006

reviews.title: We do not recommend Virgin upper class
reviews.text: We would NOT recommend Virgin upper class. We was in. upper class. They run out of Champagne, sparkling wine and white wine with four and half hours left of our journey, they said they had to save a certain amount for returning customers ?, [ doesn't Barbados sell any], The chicken pie for lunch was awful, all the pastry was soggy, Later for afternoon tea, I ordered a chicken club sandwich, to be served with 1 quarter of it, with a few crisps, [absolutely unbelievable that they thought this was acceptable], Sarah was the rudest attendant I have ever met, she ruined our flights, I even asked her to stay away from me and not to talk to me, as I was going to put a complaint in against her. Date of travel: November 2022 https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/ShowUserReviews-g1-d8729182-r871708398-Virgin_Atlantic_Airways-World.html#
reviews.author: Harry

reviews.title: NO COMMUNICATION
reviews.text: I discovered that KLM, Delta and Virgin Atlantic do not "talk" to each other's computer systems. We had our airline tickets scheduled through Norwegian Cruise Lines because of a special deal they were offering. When we recieved the flight information, it consisted of three airlines that cooperate with each other, or so we thought. We flew from Nashville, Tennessee to JFK in New York on KLM. No problems with that one. However, at the gate of our flight to Heathrow in England, the agent tells us that we were not on the flight. This was the begining of the nightmare. In all, we ended up not flying out for 24 hours. We had to get a room at the TWA airport hotel for over $400.00. We missed one whole day of vacation. This show not have happpen. I would really love to go back to the Bristish Isles but this event burned me from overseas flying.
reviews.author: Pam M

reviews.title: Ok flight
reviews.text: Great crew, not much leg room, good food, great pilot, good entrtainment, other airlines offered more on the same flight
reviews.author: BARRY L

reviews.title: Small seats, luggage damage
reviews.text: Very disappointed in this airline. The seats were smaller than the average seats. We wanted to upgrade to premium, but were told that the seats were the same, just the legroom was only an additional 3" more, so we were actually better off with the exit row. 1- The seats looked larger when we were boarding--- understand that not large, just a normal size for any other airline. 2- He failed to tell us that the side arm bars don't lift and took up more space, making our seats even smaller. So their reservations staff clearly doesn't know their planes. 2- When we arrived, our luggage was damaged--- there were two gaping holes where the metal luggage insignia had been. I was told that I could complain online, however, when I went to fill out the complaint, it clearly stated that anything cosmetic would not be compensated, only structural damage. Beware, they can rip and damage your luggage, but so long as it is still usable, they think that's fine. Well.... I don't and will not be using them again.
reviews.author: CindyNovak

reviews.title: Customer Support is essentially non-existent
reviews.text: Called multiple days in a row to make a change on our flight. Their system lost our seat selection which we paid for, so I wanted to make sure we got the seats we paid for in advance. Waited for more than an hour on hold each time and never spoke to anyone. My wife is pregnant and we chose seats specifically for her comfort, now we will be stuck with whichever seats Virgin gives us at the gate.
reviews.author: Mike R

reviews.title: Miserable service
reviews.text: i was returning back home and having a good meal in the Airport lounge i decided not to eat the meal on flight. When the stewardess came for my meal order, i distinctly instructed her that i would like to have my meal's starter and the dessert along with the breakfast in the morning. She asked me about my meal and i told that I do NOT want to have my meal. Come morning and a different stewardess comes to take my breakfast order. I told her that i have already instructed the other stewardess (in the night) about having my earlier meals starter and the dessert along with the breakfast. So kindly get me that. She got confused and sent the night stewardess to me and who totally feigned ignorance of my instructions given earlier at night. She went on to say that all the meals with the accompaniments are exhausted. I politely told that my instructions were very clear and that they should have saved my share of the starter and the dessert to serve me later with the breakfast. I told her that since that is all over, I do not want to eat the breakfast and that i will make a complaint about this failure of service on their part appropriately. She went back and somehow appeared with the night meal's starter (which was supposed to be exhausted) and offered the same but regretted that the dessert is definitely not available. I told her to take it back and give me what i had asked for. Else I do not want anything. What surprises me that on an international flight how can the airline have mediocre staffing who do not follow instructions. Same thing happened to my wife also who was with me on the flight. Virgin supposed to have excellent service when i have travelled with them earlier. In flight staff are not available post the meal service. My wife pressed the call button and no one came for an hour. My experience with a flight of BA (years back) smacked of racism and i stopped using BA service altogether. Looks like Virgin is heading the same way.
reviews.author: Bhupesh64

reviews.title: FOOD
reviews.text: Food was terrible in last 40 years of traveling i never see food that bad i ordered Muslim meal bu food t very bad then asked the chicken and also very bad taste i think they must see Emirates and Qatar Airway food
reviews.author: Niaz k

reviews.title: Excellent service and compassionate staff
reviews.text: Comfortable journey with plenty of legroom. Friendly staff. Flavia in particular was very helpful and made and effort to get me a meal meeting my dietary requirements even though I did not order one prior to flight. The food was top quality and one of the best flight meals I’ve had. The service was prompt with drinks and beverages being served throughout the flight. Overall 10/10.
reviews.author: JohnAH

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Flew recently to New York with Virgin on their Airbus really disappointed with the seats. The flight was nearly full so unable to really move around or spread out. The seats were very tight and uncomfortable, didn't appear to have any padding. The aircraft looked very dated. It seems they had added more seating to shoehorn everyone in. We have flown several times on the Boeing but certainly will not be flying economy again with Virgin. The flight attendances were all very friendly
reviews.author: Cathy H

reviews.title: Greedy and not for tall people
reviews.text: One of those greedy airlines that contrive to charge travellers extra to sit together. My wife and I were deliberately separated even though there were adjacent seats remaining. To sit together would have required us to both move seats which would have added over 20% to the cost of the tickets. Greedy greedy greedy. There needs to be much more transparency in the industry about this kind of thing. Consumers should be advised in advance before they book their tickets that they will be charged extra to sit together and the cost involved. Virgin also seem to have no appreciation if what it’s like to travel cattle class for tall people. Passengers should only be allowed to put their seats back if they want to sleep not so they can grab extra room from the poor sod behind while they watch TV. Shorter people do not appreciate that putting your own seat back does not compensate for the loss of leg room. When I asked the stewardess to get the person in front to out their seat back up for breakfast she queried why.
reviews.author: makeshift0

reviews.title: Better than British Airways
reviews.text: So in Jan 2023 I flew with Virgin Atlantic from Manchester, UK to JFK, USA. It was the first time I had flown since 2000 when I made the same journey with British Airways. I paid slightly more for an extra legroom seat, which was good as the regular seats did look a bit too cramped legroom wise for me. The cabin crew were great throughout the journey. Very helpful and always happy to comply with drink requests unlike BA who seemed to have a one drink limit for flights! There was an incident on landing when a passenger had a pop at another one but the staff handled it well and the cabin crew member sat opposite on landing seemed to be delighted when I praised her and other staff at the end of the flight. The in flight meal was okay. It was better than others I've had. The only slight downside was that the table on the seat wasn't useable by me so a careful balancing act was needed. If it could have extended out further it would have been perfect. I can't judge the in flight entertainment. With it being a day flight I was more than happy to stare at the view from the window. My return flight two weeks later was from Orlando to Manchester and again was pleased with the service. This time I had the exit row to myself so was able to use the other table for me meals. Much better. All in all I was very happy with flying with Virgin Atlantic. I would fly with them again but I don't think it will be anytime soon. This was a once in a lifetime holiday for me to fulfil my ambition to visit Washington DC, Universal Studios and NASA and pay my respects at the World Trade Center complex after going up the Towers in 2000. Bad flight experiences can ruin a holiday but this was not tje case here.
reviews.author: Gavin N

reviews.title: HORRIFIC AMOUNT OF PHONE DELAYS
reviews.text: The experience is horrifying if you need to make a change to your ticket. The website doesn't function a lot of times and the wait times for calls are over an hour. It is quite annoying to spend such a long amount of time waiting (listening to annoying music) to be connected to make a simple change to your flight ticket. Most of us don't have so much free time to spare. There can be a simple service to call back the customers. HOW DIFFICULT IS THAT? I have travelled business class with them and the experience is no different. No special lines for business class passengers.
reviews.author: Vedang

reviews.title: Flew with virgin many times
reviews.text: Yeah having flew many times with virgin to this destination we felt confident to book the whole family in a once in a lifetime vacation after all virgin in the past have been excellent but this was not the case the food was a disgrace grown men were handed orange squosh as a beverage no alcohol a choice would of been nice our 6year old grandson was told one choice of meal there was nothing else my sugars dropped they had to get me a biscuit from first class in a nutshell quite a disgrace we will never fly virgin again I gave feed back to the travel agent this holiday in total cost us 17 thousand pounds the only let down was flying virgin Atlantic thankyou
reviews.author: Glenise S

reviews.title: Flight VS3
reviews.text: The flight to New York was fabulous , very comfortable seats and the cabin crew were first class . Special mention to Rebecca and Charlotte you were stars , we can’t thank you enough . The flight itself was on time and would recommend Virgin Airlines , thank you all for attentive service .
reviews.author: jim

reviews.title: Fantastic Customer Service
reviews.text: The customer service was fantastic! The people in JFK were so helpful! We had a flight cancel on us with another airline & booked this at the last minute. They gave us seats with great legroom and nobody in the middle seat so we could be comfortable. Wonderful food & service!
reviews.author: Antoinette B

reviews.title: Had a Good Experience for 10 hours in Premium Economy
reviews.text: I would have given 5 stars but my return flight the food was just okay. Outbound though the food was really good! Though more importantly, was the legroom, which I was really happy about. My seat was comfortable and I was pretty satisfied. They did change my outbound seat from what I initially selected, a window seat to a center aisle seat but still it wasn't a bad flying experience. I'll book again with Virgin Atlantic.
reviews.author: elainee821

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Booked a Virgin multi destination trip to USA 7 flights & 4 hotels. LHR -Vegas & LA back to LHR great, 2 of the other 5 flights got cancelled (one cancelled twice) they used Delta airlines who are worse than Ryanair! If we hadn’t of sort it ourselves (flew Alaskan airlines) we would of had one day in San Francisco not 3!! When we complained virgin as good as said they don’t care ‘YOU got it sorted’ We are in our 70’s with health issues, good job we used our initiative or our trip of a lifetime would of been ruined, their after sales customer service stinks!! would never use again- just booked Caribbean cruise with Tui :)
reviews.author: Terri

reviews.title: Seat broken!!!!!! So moved sit by bar for 13 hour flight
reviews.text: Cannot believe that a seat that has been sold at upper class price has been broken and not repaired since last flight. What a joke. Why would anyone choose to on plane with poor maintenance.
reviews.author: ASHLEY J

reviews.title: Flying Upper class- ABSOLUTELY AWFUL
reviews.text: I flew upper class from London to Austin and my experience has been absolutely awful. If Spirit airlines had a business class , this would be it. the so called "cabins" are a JOKE. I've NEVER flown first class in such a crammed janky "cabin". I am skinny female and i still felt ultra crammed. there is literally ZERO privacy between you and whoever sitting next to you (think how close you sit next to someone in coach), it is most certainly NOT a suite or a cabin, you cannot recline the bed without literally having to call a flight attendant to do it for you. i am NOT kidding, THEY HAVE TO DO IT FOR YOU and you have to get up for it (its manual). my elbows felt jammed into the sides of this so called cabin . i think i flown coach and felt more comfortable. their marketing is a LIE. as it it turns out they have a few planes that have suites like any other normal airline, but most of their new planes are like this. theres is a useless bar at the back of the first class section that noone uses that takes up a lot of room, but the cabins are crammed and they tried to jam as many as they can. forget if you are over 6 feet tall, you wont fit and your feet would be hanging into the walkway (all cabins are angled toward the middle of the plane so your feet are facing the walkway. i am 5.9 and mine were hanging off. LITERALLY THE WORST FIRST CLASS EXPERIENCE EVER. I WOULD NEVER EVER fly virgin again. they should be ashamed to call this first class. SHAME ON YOU VIRGIN.
reviews.author: mrsliv11206

reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Having always travelled with BA had begun to forget what great service looks like Airline stewardess Shirley from Newcastle was an absolute Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.author: Gerry G

reviews.title: One of the best companies
reviews.text: Its truely a great experiance. The flight was smooth, great new plains, friendly staff, the service is always amazing. Premium seats are very cozy
reviews.author: Katker

reviews.title: Have not even flown yet- VERY disappointed
reviews.text: Planned this trip a year ago and purchased upper class seating for RT to Geneva for entire family. First they changed my flight so layover was 45 mins (not going to work on int'l) and then asked me to take a flight the next day instead. I pointed out they had a flight leaving 3 hours later and they finally agreed to put us on that one. Went to choose seats and there are only 2 available for choosing. There are 3 of us. Called them and they said we have to wait until we are at the airport to get our seats as they reserved them for the gate agents. So now we have a son, who is not a good traveler, seating apart from us? I will NEVER fly Virgin again.
reviews.author: Philthy07

reviews.title: Virgin Atlantic. The long haul Easy jet!
reviews.text: My fist time flying with Virgin Atlantic, and my last. Cramped rock-hard seats, appalling food and outdated and old entertainment system that indicates that they are using quite old aircraft compared to the competition. We flew to Jamaica in early May 2023. The food reminded me of school dinners breakfast consisted of a bread finger roll with egg in it wrapped inside silver foil, really. I asked for some orange juice and got squash, what am I five years old. Talk about saving pennies. I particularly enjoyed the challenge of spreading a frozen rock-hard piece of butter onto my soft roll using a flimsy plastic knife while bumping elbows with my companion and everyone who passed me in the isle. While my breakfast rolled off the small table because it wasn’t level. Next the culinary delight of chicken and mash that tasted like wallpaper paste. I remember my mouth being so dry I was gasping for a drink as the drinks trolley went by. Yep, you’ve guessed it more squash. But I didn’t care it had been so long since I had, had a drink the steward noticed I drank it all in one go so she said. Would you like some more. She filled it up halfway. Cattle are treated better I thought. I did wonder what upper-class were receiving at this point. Our return flight actually managed to achieve what I thought was impossible, go downhill from the outbound flight. Virgin cancelled our flight ten minutes before we were due to board the coach to the airport. Rescheduled to the next day. We learned this from a text. Completely leaving us to deal with the problem of accommodation ourselves. In the ned we had to pay out of our own pocket $450 to stay an extra night one couple on honeymoon were told they would have to rebook themselves and discovered they would not be on a flight until the Wednesday four day later. Which would cost them $1800 our flight the next day would also be going via Nassau Bahamas where we would have to remain on the tarmac for and hour and a half making the long flight home even longer. And all done to maximise profits using one aircraft instead of two direct flights. All at the passenger’s expense. I previously travelled on Emirates and British airways both are infinitely better airlines. Emirates was amazing even in economy. Virgin Atlantic reminded me of easyJet just not as cheap. At least with easyJet you know exactly what to expect. To get to your destination at the lowest possible cost. Virgin Atlantic I always thought was a premium airline. I am now in the process of trying to get my money back from them for my hotel costs I incurred because of them. It’s so convoluted and difficult. It’s almost as if Ricard Branson (net worth 5 billion) doesn’t want to make it easy for his customers to get their own money back. Might I suggest Mr Branson spend some of the money allocated on his space jaunts on the reputation of his airline because his appalling airline affects real hard-working people who save all year to pay for their annual holiday and deserve better treatment. Other airlines manage it.
reviews.author: James R

reviews.title: Terrible virgin just terrible
reviews.text: Booked the whole package holiday with virgin as we have in the past. Flight times got changed so many times. We Travelled back from antiqua on a virgin flight as we were unable to book premium economy so had to have economy. What a bad service. Food was totally inedible. I wouldn’t have given it to my dog, people were complaining to the stewardess who just said we can’t get good food from antiqua which of course is rubbish. We were sat by the exits which we thought that’s good more legroom but one of the toilets were out of action so people were cutting across us to get to the other toilet. People were tripping over and treading on our feet. We loved the resort but that’s nothing to do with virgin they just use them. British airways have been far better of recent years and we have literally just booked to go back to Antigua and £ 2k cheaper WITH BRITISH AIRWAYS Virgin has lost it I’m afraid , poor service Gave it one star as you can’t give no stars
reviews.author: Keith B

reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: Flew in economy from Heathrow to Miami on Virgin Atlantic during Easter 2023. Overall the service and flight was better than expected and substantially better than TUI and British Airways on long haul flights. Online booking process and check in at the airport was painless and efficient. The staff were polite and fun. Flight departed on time both ways and arrived early each time. Considering I'm 6'1 in height, the legroom was adequate although a little tight when the seat in front reclined. In future I'd probably book the delight seats just to have a little more room. But I found it to be better than BA and TUI. Meal on the way out was excellent but on the way back it was pretty terrible, and even the staff were painfully aware of this - commenting that there were issues with the US suppliers. Drinks service was decent but perhaps should have had one more round. The only gripe was that the seatback entertainment system was glitchy with most games unavailable and the whole system collapsing on two separate occasions. Overall I was reasonably satisfied with the flights and will be my go to choice for long haul flights in future where possible
reviews.author: Guy

reviews.title: Premium economy waste of money
reviews.text: Three of us flew Virgin Premium Economy from Manchester to Orlando. The food was really disappointing and very dehydrated. Also throughout the 8hr 30 min flight all the stewards were mainly concentrating on upper class and not our cabin. We were only offered drinks on 2 occasions throughout the flight. Another annoying thing was the amount of screaming children on the flight being allowed to kick the back of seats and running around the cabin. Again this could have been addressed if the staff on board were in the premium section. I have always held virgin as one of the best companies to fly with, however this has really made us think twice about using them again.
reviews.author: Paul G

reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text: I reached the airport for boarding 55 minutes prior to departure. They clearly declined the boarding and it was an unprecedented situation occurred as the train got delayed. Their response was just we can’t do anything, please reschedule your flight. I understand their are guidelines for them to follow but if situations are not favourable , response can’t be we don’t care. And they make me delayed by checking the same thing again and again for almost half an hour. Truly horrifying customer service and checkin experience.
reviews.author: pritam s

reviews.title: Amazingly good food and service
reviews.text: Virgin Atlantic Upper Class food as good as Qatar and the crew was extremely pleasant and efficient. The chief flight attendant personally spoke with every passenger in Upper Class. We "bidded" for the upgrade and initially thought we had paid too much; but it was worth it.
reviews.author: WJ60

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I flew to Miami and back with Virgin in May 2023 on a 787. I had originally booked premium on the way out but upgraded to upper because I wanted to get some sleep. The impression on entering the cabin was that it was all very cramped. Even the corridors were narrow as was my compartment. I was in the Central row and there was no privacy. I was looking directly at the people in the window seats opposite. It certainly compares badly with other business classes I have experienced. Having said that I appreciated the club lounges on the way out and on the way back. I also made use of the revival lounge at Heathrow on the way back. And everywhere the service was excellent. But I did feel Virgin are ‘packing em in’ to maximise profit and relaxing it certainly wasn’t.
reviews.author: cilc213

reviews.title: The holiday starts at VA
reviews.text: It is hobson's choice to fly direct from London to Montego Bay, and VA offers a better customer service and travel experience when compared to the other tour operation (T??). Pro's: a) Good service from the ground staff and flight crew. Con's a) VA are allowing passengers to take-on board too many hand-luggage. This spoils the experience. b) Flight crew not dealing with bad behaving passengers. This spoils the travel experience.
reviews.author: orlando_32

reviews.title: OK but room for improvement
reviews.text: I don't really want to gripe too much here, Virgin Atlantic are a good airline, much better than some other carriers, but for me there is room for improvement. First, no complaints about the planes, clean and comfortable; crew were OK, I've certainly had more friendly crews on Virgin flights, but it was the flight itself which irritated me and the key word here is personally. When I return home, I like to put myself on UK time as quickly as I can so as to adjust more quickly. This flight left SFO at 22.20 (6.30am UK time), so I didn't want a full dinner at breakfast time. 4/5 hours into the flight, the crew come slamming down the window shades and call the flight a "night flight", despite it now being mid-morning in the UK and there are eye shades in the amenity kit given out. I personally paid for a window seat to be able to look out of the window and I really object to airlines telling me I have to close it. As another example on the flight we were advised that there was someone with a nut allergy on board so "no eating nuts", but I wasn't allowed to look out of the window! Similarly, 90 minutes before landing, breakfast was serves which was approximately 3pm UK, not what I wanted to eat. So I feel Virgin got this flight wrong. The wrong meal, served at the wrong time, with the wrong night flight designation - but I have to say, the outbound flight to Boston was perfect - a tail of two flights!
reviews.author: Anders B

reviews.title: Unbelievable serve
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about the food and service on virgin Atlantic upper class. The seating arrangement on the old A330 – 300s is weird as you were staring across the aisle at your neighbors. But, I have honestly never experienced as professional and thoughtful and friendly service with such good food on an airplane.
reviews.author: WJ60

reviews.title: VA hit rock bottom
reviews.text: VA hit the bottom. We flew out in March 2023 (LHR to SFO) in "Upper Class" (and that on it's own is a ridiculous VA claim). The seats were incredibly narrow, and inward facing, which means that if you wish to view take off/landing, you will end up with a cricked neck. Our seats were not very clean, my table mechanism was faulty. Finding the USB slot is impossible and when I did find it, it did not work, BTW...the guy 2 seats back, had a faulty chair and had to move. I only mention that because 4 years ago we flew back from Dubai in premium economy and my wife's chair was also broken and she had to sit in it, in the fully reclined position for 7 hours. The guy behind her must have been very unhappy. Back to my flight, the wines listed in the menu were unavailable. Food...no red meat option! Amazing. The in flight entertainment was weak and even the safety video must be 8 years old. Staff were at least pleasant. Return flight, LAS to LHR, wines listed again not available. This time I challenged one of the staff and we went quite close to having a full blown argument over it. She was either mistaken or simply lied to me. For the rest of that night flight, she must have walked past me and hit my feet 3 times whilst I tried to sleep in the inadequately short bed. I am only 5ft 9". Poor food, very poor. wilted and dried out greens. Cheese board was lamentable... 3 pieces, one of which was the size of a postage stamp. Believe it..I am not exaggerating. My wife, one seat back, was served her meal fully 40 mins before I was. USB slot again was out of order. Staff, this time not nice. Considering 2 return flights at £5k and our previous experience, I am compelled to say that Virgin Atlantic are a joke. They are clearly not investing in their fleet and seem happy to run outdated and broken equipment. They clearly don't pay their wine bill on time, hence constantly replacing wines for those shown on the menu cards. How difficult would it be to print new ones for the flights affected? The likes of Qatar and Emirates are miles ahead of VA. VA are non-league. They even make BA look good. VA may as well fold, it has that air about it anyway. Reduced destinations, over-priced and poor value. I will NEVER fly VA ever again.
reviews.author: WeirdFish63

reviews.title: Not upto the mark.
reviews.text: Aircraft wonderful. Crew not so pleasant. No wheelchair provided at Heathrow Terminal 3. All wheelchair buggies diverted to transfer passengers ! This is the third time this hs happened. Utomatic window shades disabled to dark. Could not see the dawn. Or stars. Requested. But crew said it disturbs passengers!
reviews.author: pm

reviews.title: Faultless
reviews.text: Hubby and I flew to Florida for the 2nd time with Virgin. Impeccable service from start to finish. Our return flight was a night flight. I CANNOT sleep on a plane and was dreading the flight home. I managed to secure an upgrade via Virgin's bidding system.... OMG the best money I have ever spent. The service, from check in, to the Delta Sky Lounge, to Danny and John Paul on the aircraft... there was nothing to find fault in. Food and drink were perfect. Seats/bed we're so comfy. Thank you so much... I better start saving my pennies for next time
reviews.author: Kerin Testo
